chunks: From him, from Uthman ibn Isa, from Sama'ah ibn Mihran, who said:
I asked him about the divorce of the pregnant woman, so he said: One divorce, and her waiting period is until she gives birth to her pregnancy.

key_terms.تَضَعُ حَمْلَهَا: She gives birth to her pregnancy
key_terms.وَاحِدَةٌ: One (referring to a single revocable divorce)

ai.seo_question: What is the waiting period for a pregnant woman who is divorced?
ai.summary: In this hadith from al-Istibsar, Samarakah ibn Mihran conveys the ruling that a pregnant woman receives a single revocable divorce, with her iddah extending until parturition as per the Quranic mandate. This narration is pivotal in Shia jurisprudence for clarifying that the completion of the waiting period is tied to the physical act of childbirth rather than a fixed lunar duration, ensuring the woman's status is clearly defined post-divorce. It underscores the practical application of Quranic verses in determining the timeline for remarriage and the finality of the divorce.
